taxonomic_note: Accepted by current POWO; historical varieties are treated within the species under the current project concept.
look_here_first: Start at the nodes and inflorescence: a taller plant with conspicuously ridged stems, broader opposite leaves, and paired axillary condensed cymes subtended by broad obovate bracts.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is voucher-backed by UT Plant Resources Center; Kerr is voucher-backed by the Flora of Kerr Wildlife Management Area (JS 18023). Regional south-central Texas occurrence is not decomposed into extra counties.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification. Preserve the two-county HOLD.

best_field_traits: perennial herb, often much taller than Dyschoriste linearis
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Taller and broader-leaved than Dyschoriste linearis, with paired bracted cymes instead of solitary axillary flowers.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Ridged stem + broader opposite leaves + paired axillary bracted cymes.
